text:
I'm glad he seems okay. Even so, please still contact your vet or local poison control today. Cats can look fine at first, and they can tell you whether he needs to be seen or watched. Your case is already escalated to a Support Lead, so you don't need to do anything more on our side.

For a plant that won't hurt him, these Leafy plants are listed as pet-safe:
- Calathea
- Spider plant
- Parlour palm
- Boston fern
- Peperomia

I don't have more detail than that on each one. For care tips or help choosing for your light level, a Plant Care Specialist is available by chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri (your local time) or by email at help@leafy.example, answered within 1 business day.

Some things to know if you're thinking of ordering:
- Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. An order placed after 12 noon Wednesday ships the following Monday.
- Live plants can't be returned for change of mind, so it's worth choosing carefully.

Would you like help with anything else, such as shipping times to your area?
